The '''Senate Commercial District''' or '''Commerce Hall''' was a commercial complex built underneath the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Layout==
Accessible by two stairways along the [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|avenue]] leading to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], the district was home to a wide variety of shops and stores run by all manner of beings. It consisted of two separate wings. The western wing was directly underneath the [[Garden of Justice]], while the eastern wing was beneath the [[Garden of Equality]]. The two were connected by a hallway that ran around the north, east, and west sides of the avenue, with several trade consoles connected to the Galactic Trade Network in the northern section of the hallway. The district was home to [[Mariyk]]'s cantina, as well as a Republic security base. Several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi Consular]]s made their bases there as well, taking advantage of the district's central location and ample resources to aid them in their missions and their training of young Jedi.

==Behind the scenes==
The Senate Commercial District first appeared in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it serves as the central hub on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for vendors, skill trainers, trainers, and trade consoles.
